name: DroneLog
description: DroneLog is a dual-task UAV flight telemetry benchmark designed for airframe identification and payload state recognition. The benchmark contains 50 real-world flight sessions collected from five quadrotor platforms with frame sizes of 250, 450, 500, 650, and 680 mm, all equipped with PX4-based Pixhawk flight controllers. The benchmark is organized into two sub-datasets: Frame Size Sub-dataset:Contains 15 flight sessions, comprising three flights for each of the five frame-size classes.
